summary: ESG Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a split-off transaction on May 26, 2026, where it transferred 100% of ESG China Limited shares to certain holders in exchange for the surrender and cancellation of 10,432,800 shares of its common stock (approximately 40% of outstanding shares). The transaction was executed pursuant to a Split-Off and Share Exchange Agreement dated April 10, 2026. No advisor or board recommendation is disclosed. After the split-off, ESG China ceased to be a subsidiary, and 15,475,468 shares remain outstanding. The company will continue its North America operations through ESG Provisions, Inc. Watch for potential subsequent shareholder actions or activism given the concentrated ownership change.
